## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the source revision, checks performed and relevant results. Separate local tests, CI, artifact checks, deployment and live proof. Explicitly identify skipped checks. Include synthetic desktop/mobile screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe any API, permission, migration or deployment changes and rollback constraints. Write "None" when applicable.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation links, generated facts and third-party notices are current.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated distributions are included.
